long_biography.plain_text:
Minev moved from work at First Financial Brokerage House into banking, establishing First Investment Bank with Ivaylo Mutafchiev in 1993. The institution initially focused on corporate clients and later developed retail services, international payment products and digital banking. Minev retained a substantial holding as the company became publicly traded and expanded in southeast Europe.

His athletic background also shaped two decades of sports administration. A former member of Bulgaria's national water-polo team and an enthusiastic skier, he took over the Bulgarian Ski Federation in 2003. He later became a vice-president of the Bulgarian Olympic Committee and entered the FIS Council, combining federation governance with the organisation of Alpine and snowboard World Cup events in Bulgaria.
